6º de Primaria · Inglés

Going to and will

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

Si dices «el sábado voy a ir al cine» y «creo que mañana lloverá», ¿hablas del futuro de la misma manera?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

No exactamente. «Voy a ir» es un plan que ya has decidido: en inglés, I'm going to go. «Lloverá» es una predicción, lo que crees que pasará: I think it will rain. El inglés tiene dos formas principales para el futuro: going to y will.

2

Aprende9 bloques cortos

Two ways to talk about the future

In English we often use be going to for plans and intentions (things we decided before): «I'm going to visit my grandparents this weekend». We use will for predictions, quick decisions and promises: «I think it will be sunny», «I'll help you!».

En castellano: going to se parece a «ir a + infinitivo» («voy a visitar»), y will se parece al futuro («visitaré», «ayudaré»). No es una traducción exacta, pero ayuda mucho a recordarlo.

Going to: form

The form is: am / is / are + going to + verb. «I'm going to learn the guitar», «She's going to be a vet», «We're going to play a match on Sunday».

Negative: «I'm not going to watch TV tonight», «He isn't going to come». Question: «Are you going to buy a present?» – «Yes, I am. / No, I'm not». «What are you going to do at the weekend?». En castellano: fíjate en que el verbo to be cambia con la persona, igual que en el presente continuo.

Plans and evidence

We use going to for plans: «Next summer we're going to travel to Italy. We've got the tickets!». We also use it for predictions with evidence (cuando vemos una prueba ahora): «Look at those black clouds! It's going to rain», «Be careful! You're going to fall!».

En castellano: si ves algo que te hace estar casi seguro de lo que va a pasar (nubes negras, alguien que tropieza), usa going to.

Will: form

The form of will is the same for all persons: will + verb. «I will go», «she will go», «they will go». The short form is 'll: I'll, you'll, she'll, we'll.

Negative: won't (will not): «It won't snow tomorrow». Question: «Will you come to my party?» – «Yes, I will. / No, I won't». Careful: after will the verb has no -s and no to: «she will play», not «she will plays» or «will to play».

Vídeo: Simple future (will): inglés para niños · Inglés para niños con Mr Pea (YouTube) · 763 mil visualizaciones

Will for predictions

We use will to say what we think or believe about the future, often with I think, I'm sure, probably, maybe: «I think Spain will win the match», «In 2050 people will probably travel in flying cars», «Maybe robots will do our homework!».

En castellano: son opiniones o adivinanzas, sin una prueba que estemos viendo. «I think…» = «creo que…». «I don't think it will rain» = «no creo que llueva».

Will for decisions and promises

We use will when we decide something at the moment of speaking (en el momento): «It's cold in here.» – «I'll close the window». «What would you like?» – «I'll have a sandwich, please».

We also use it for promises and offers (promesas y ofrecimientos): «I'll always be your friend», «Don't worry, I won't tell anyone», «Shall I help you?» – «Thank you!».

Going to or will?

Compare: «I'm going to study Medicine» (a plan, I decided it before) and «Oh, the phone! I'll answer it» (a decision now). «Look at the sky! It's going to snow» (evidence) and «I think it will snow at Christmas» (opinion).

Time words for the future: tomorrow, tonight, next week, next year, this weekend, in the future, soon, one day. En castellano: la palabra de tiempo no decide la forma; lo que decide es si es un plan, una prueba o una opinión.

Reading: my plans for the future

Read Lucía's text: «Next year I'm going to start secondary school. I'm a bit nervous, but I think it will be fun. I'm going to join the school choir because I love singing. When I grow up, I'm going to be a marine biologist. I'll study dolphins and whales. I'm sure the oceans will need our help, so I won't stop fighting for them. Maybe one day I'll live on a boat!»

Let's practise: my future box

Write a «future box» (una caja del futuro) to open at the end of secondary school. Write three plans with going to and three predictions with will: «Next summer I'm going to learn to surf», «I think I'll be taller than my dad».

Then interview a partner: «What are you going to do this weekend?», «Do you think you'll live in another country?». Consejo: pregunta con Are you going to…? para planes y con Will you…? o Do you think you'll…? para predicciones.

Ejemplos resueltos

Ejemplo 1. Complete with going to: «We (paint) ___ my bedroom tomorrow. We've bought the paint.»

  1. Es un plan decidido antes (ya hay pintura).
  2. We + are + going to + paint.

Resultado: We're going to paint my bedroom tomorrow.

Ejemplo 2. Choose: «The phone is ringing!» «I (answer / 'm going to answer) it.»

  1. Decisión en el momento → will.
  2. I'll answer it.

Resultado: I'll answer it.

Ejemplo 3. Make it negative: «It will snow tonight.»

  1. Negativa de will: won't + verbo.

Resultado: It won't snow tonight.

Errores típicos

  • Olvidar el verbo to be: «I going to play» → «I'm going to play».
  • Poner -s o to tras will: «she will plays», «will to go» → «she will play», «will go».
  • Decir «willn't» → «won't».
  • Usar will para un plan ya decidido: «I will visit Rome next week, I have the tickets» → «I'm going to visit».
  • Confundir going to (futuro) con going (ir): «I'm going to the cinema» es «voy al cine».

Ejercicios

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

  1. Complete: «She ___ (be) a doctor when she grows up.» (going to)

    Ver solución
    is going to be.

  2. Make it negative: «They are going to play tennis.»

    Ver solución
    They aren't going to play tennis.

  3. Make a question: «You are going to buy a new bike.»

    Ver solución
    Are you going to buy a new bike?

  4. Complete with will or won't: «Don't worry, I ___ tell your secret.»

    Ver solución
    won't.

  5. What's the short form of «I will»?

    Ver solución
    I'll.

  6. Choose: «Look! That boy (will fall / is going to fall)!»

    Ver solución
    is going to fall (hay una prueba).

  7. Choose: «I'm thirsty.» «I (will get / am going to get) you some water.»

    Ver solución
    will get (decisión en el momento).

  8. Correct: «I think it will raining tomorrow.»

    Ver solución
    I think it will rain tomorrow.

  9. Translate: «El año que viene voy a aprender a nadar.»

    Ver solución
    Next year I'm going to learn to swim.

  10. Write one plan and one prediction about next summer.

    Ver solución
    Model answer: I'm going to go camping. I think it will be very hot.

Para familias

  • El domingo, contad en inglés los planes de la semana: «On Monday I'm going to…».
  • Jugad a adivinar el futuro de la familia en 2050 con frases con will.
  • Repasad juntos las tarjetas del paso 6 dos minutos al día durante una semana.

Para profesores

Saberes: Expresión de planes, intenciones, predicciones y promesas; futuro con be going to y will (Lengua Extranjera) (RD 157/2022, tercer ciclo de Primaria).

  • Cápsula del tiempo con planes y predicciones para abrir en 4º de ESO.
  • Previsión del tiempo de la semana presentada como en la tele.
  • Juego de rol en una cafetería: I'll have…

Qué vas a aprender

  • Talk about plans with going to (planes)
  • Make predictions with will and with going to (predicciones)
  • Use will for quick decisions and promises
  • Make negatives and questions with both forms

Palabras clave

future · be going to · plans · will / 'll · won't · predictions · promises · tomorrow · next week

Tiempo

50 minutos hoy + 2 minutos en cada repaso
